title: Type-Safe Context
description: Create type-safe React Context with TypeScript.

data.text: React Context combined with TypeScript provides a type-safe way to manage global state across your application.

data.title: Type-Safe Context

terms.definition: React's way to pass data through the component tree
Component that provides context value to children

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Always create a custom hook to consume context. This provides a better error message and makes the API cleaner.

data.title: Context Typing Steps
items: Create context with undefined as default
Create a custom hook with error handling

data.title: Exercise: Create an Auth Context
data.description: Build a typed auth context with user state and login/logout functions.
steps: Define AuthContextValue interface with user, login, and logout
Create AuthProvider with useState for user
Use the context in a component
data.expectedOutcome: A fully typed auth context with safe consumer access.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Define an interface for context value
Use undefined as initial value for type safety
Create a custom hook for consuming context
Throw descriptive errors when context is missing
data.takeaway: Type-safe Context makes global state management reliable and self-documenting.
